title: Audit Route
description: A single auditor CLI route entry in the route registry. Codex is forbidden as an auditor_tool; it is not present in embedded_audit.schema.json auditor_tool enum.

cli_name.description: Logical name matching the PAL clink config (e.g. claude-audit).

command.description: Executable to probe for on PATH (e.g. claude, gemini). Must not be codex.

priority.description: Selection priority; lower value means higher preference.

additional_args.description: Extra CLI arguments passed verbatim to the auditor.

env.description: Extra environment variables for the invocation.

role.description: PAL clink role name to activate (default: codereviewer).
